factual_basis_before: Accessible reporting attributes to the hospital’s complaint a 2024 purchase, October 2025 AI analysis, surgical reliance on an inflammatory interpretation, later OSU cancer diagnosis, repeat surgery and postoperative death. It separately reports alleged post-notification report modification and a conference-call apology with acknowledgement of similar errors. These remain civil allegations. The July 30 complaint sought at least $50,000, not an awarded loss. A September 8 docket proxy records removal and scheduling, not a liability finding. The original/amended report, patient decision records and full complaint were not recovered. The precise independent clinical basis and causal chain remain unresolved.
